info.name: Kiteworks API Documentation activities notifications API

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the folder.

params.name: includeNested
params.description: Set notification for nested folders as well

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs: Creates or updates the current user's notification subscription for the specified folder. Optionally applies the same settings to all nested subfolders. Returns HTTP 201 if a new subscription was created, or HTTP 200 if an existing one was updated.

params.name: userId
params.description: Filter notifications by the ID of the user who receives them.

params.name: userId:in
params.description: Filter notifications by the ID of the user who receives them.. Search for results that match any of the specified values for this parameter.

params.name: objectId
params.description: Filter notifications by the ID of the folder they are associated with.

params.name: objectId:in
params.description: Filter notifications by the ID of the folder they are associated with.. Search for results that match any of the specified values for this parameter.

params.name: fileAdded
params.description: Filter notifications triggered when a file is added.

params.name: commentAdded
params.description: Filter notifications triggered when a comment is added.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of notification subscriptions for the current user, including the folder each subscription is for and the enabled notification types.

params.name: object_id
params.description: Object ID of the folder to remove notification options

items.docs: Unsubscribes the current user from all notifications for the specified folder.
